title: RANKING THE BEST PORSCHE BOXSTER GENERATIONS
hook: Porsche's Boxster lineup is a fascinating journey of evolution and refinement. At number four, we have the 986 Boxster S. This was the one that started it all in 1997, introducing Porsche's mid-engine magic at $50,000. With its distinctive oval headlights and classic five-spoke wheels, it set a new benchmark for roadster design.
narration: Porsche's Boxster lineup is a fascinating journey of evolution and refinement. At number four, we have the 986 Boxster S. This was the one that started it all in 1997, introducing Porsche's mid-engine magic at $50,000. With its distinctive oval headlights and classic five-spoke wheels, it set a new benchmark for roadster design. Then came the 987.2 Boxster S, enhancing performance with 310 horsepower for $58,000. Featuring dual exhaust tips and revised taillights, its value proposition has aged well, with current values climbing to $56,000. The 981 Boxster GTS upped the ante in 2014. For $73,000, it offered 330 hp and a naturally aspirated engine that enthusiasts adore. Blackened headlights and GTS badging made it a standout, combining peak performance with a classy exterior. Taking the top spot is the 718 Boxster GTS 4.0—a modern classic that reintroduced the flat-six engine in 2020 for $90,000. Its 394 horsepower and center-mounted exhaust encapsulate the perfect blend of power and Porsche legacy, now valued at $130,000. Which Boxster generation revs your engine: the original 986, the value-packed 987.2, the alluring 981 GTS, or the modern classic 718 GTS 4.0?
theme: AI-researched draft for request: Rank the 4 best Porsche Boster generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
